name: What are the signs of hidden water damage under my flooring?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of hidden water damage under my flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of hidden water damage can include discoloration or staining on walls or ceilings below the affected floor, a persistent musty odor, warped or buckling floorboards, and loose or bubbling resilient flooring. Soft spots when walking on the floor, or unusual increases in your utility bills (indicating a leak), can also point to hidden issues. Prompt investigation is crucial to prevent further structural damage and mold growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hidden water damage signs include discoloration, musty odors, warped or buckling floors, soft spots, and increased utility bills. Prompt investigation is crucial.
